clue.text: Some baht 'ats on Ilkley recalled setup for plant rotation

indicators.note: called back, so the run is taken from right to left instead of the usual way
only some of the following run of letters is wanted, a part lifted from inside the words

parts.note: the letters running across the end of baht, through 'ats and on, into the start of Ilkley

explanation.surface: A nod to the Yorkshire song On Ilkla Moor Baht 'at, about going hatless on the moor, turned into gardening kit.
explanation.walkthrough: Baht 'at is Yorkshire dialect for without a hat. Read backwards, the run gives KLINOSTAT.
explanation.definitionFit: A klinostat is a slowly revolving apparatus that turns growing plants so gravity acts on them evenly.

clue.text: Objectively we must trail a thousand silver birds of New Caledonia

the object form of the pronoun we

explanation.walkthrough: Trail means come after, so the pronoun goes at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: The kagu is a crested, nearly flightless grey bird found only on the Pacific island group of New Caledonia.

clue.text: Agent to detain United Nations IT director

the standard abbreviation
chief information officer, the executive in charge of IT

explanation.definitionFit: An internuncio is a papal envoy ranking below a nuncio, a diplomatic representative acting for the Pope.

clue.text: Where to bath — for Marat it may be fatal

French où

explanation.surface: Marat was famously stabbed to death in his bath, so for him the bath was where it all ended.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase for Marat tells you to put the three words into French, the language of Jean-Paul Marat, killed in his bath in 1793.
explanation.definitionFit: Ouabain is a heart poison from African plants, once used on arrow tips, so a dose can be lethal.

clue.text: Tough guy primarily after violence?

explanation.definitionFit: Thuggo is a slang term for a thug, a brutish man prone to fighting and intimidation.

clue.text: Assume a valley's shape shows deposits from Alpine glaciations

taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: The Donau glaciation is the name for an early Pleistocene stage of Alpine ice advance, also used for its gravel deposits.

clue.text: Maldivian shady bar flanking Hotel Hawaii

clue.text: Indian barber clipped collar

explanation.walkthrough: Collar is a verb here, not a shirt part; barber is the definition, and clipped fits his trade.
explanation.definitionFit: Nai is the Hindi word for a barber, the traditional caste occupation of hair-cutting in India.

clue.text: Poorly edited cuts to deselect with a mouse

explanation.definitionFit: Rhyming slang: Uncle Dick stands for sick, and feeling poorly is British for being unwell.

clue.text: Golf ball no longer used in public tee area

explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both wordplay and definition: the gutta was the gutta-percha golf ball of the 1800s, no longer used on any tee.
explanation.definitionFit: Gutta is short for gutta-percha, the rubbery latex from which nineteenth-century golf balls were moulded before the rubber-core era.

explanation.walkthrough: Silk is a barrister, not a fabric; KC goes round the rest as the crust.
explanation.definitionFit: Koulibiac is a Russian pastry pie filled with salmon or other fish, rice and eggs.

clue.text: Am I getting frantic with medium emergencies?
